description: Returns a public page or PDF as Markdown, in chunks, with a paid upgrade link. Use when an agent needs one URL's readable text. Not for JavaScript-only pages or crawling whole sites; use the linked paid tool for those. Default chunk is 20,000 characters; start_index reads later chunks within the free 100,000-character window. On long pages, call outline (headings) or find (matching paragraphs) first, then read the needed section with start_index. Apify Actor links can be paid with x402 via Apify, no Apify account needed.

find.description: Return only paragraphs containing any of these space-separated words (case-insensitive), each with its start_index. Overrides outline.

outline.description: Return only the page's Markdown headings, each with its start_index.

name: read_url
